instruction: Exchange item_a in slot_left and item_b in slot_right. Each slot holds at most one item. Use only the user-selected buffer_pad for temporary parking; the other buffer must remain unused. Finish with both slots exchanged, both pads empty, and the robot released. The required buffer_pad is unspecified. The user specifies buffer_pad=buffer_front.
